import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open BigOperators Real Nat Topology Rat

theorem bounded_common_multiple_radical_identity (b k : ℕ)    (h2 : 2 ∣ k) (h3 : 3 ∣ k) :
    Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) ^ k) - ((b : ℝ) ^ k) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3) =
      (b : ℝ) ^ (k / 2) - (b : ℝ) ^ (k / 3) := by
  have h_sqrt : Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) ^ k) = (b : ℝ) ^ (k / 2) := by
    obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := h2
    have hdiv : 2 * m / 2 = m := by omega
    rw [hdiv]
    have h_pow : (b : ℝ) ^ (2 * m) = ((b : ℝ) ^ m) ^ 2 := by
      rw [mul_comm, pow_mul]
    rw [h_pow]
    exact Real.sqrt_sq (by positivity)
  
  have h_cbrt : ((b : ℝ) ^ k) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3) = (b : ℝ) ^ (k / 3) := by
    obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := h3
    have hb : 0 ≤ (b : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg b
    have hdiv : 3 * m / 3 = m := by omega
    rw [hdiv]
    rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul hb]
    have h_exp : ((3 * m : ℕ) : ℝ) * ((1 : ℝ) / 3) = (m : ℝ) := by
      push_cast
      ring
    rw [h_exp, Real.rpow_natCast]
  
  rw [h_sqrt, h_cbrt]

      (b : ℝ) ^ (k / 2) - (b : ℝ) ^ (k / 3) := by
  have hb : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (b : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hk2 : k = 2 * (k / 2) := by rw [Nat.mul_comm, Nat.div_mul_cancel h2]
  have hk3 : k = 3 * (k / 3) := by rw [Nat.mul_comm, Nat.div_mul_cancel h3]
  have hk2_cast : (k : ℝ) = 2 * ((k / 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    calc (k : ℝ) = ((2 * (k / 2) : ℕ) : ℝ) := by rw [← hk2]
      _ = 2 * ((k / 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by push_cast; ring
  have hk3_cast : (k : ℝ) = 3 * ((k / 3 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    calc (k : ℝ) = ((3 * (k / 3) : ℕ) : ℝ) := by rw [← hk3]
      _ = 3 * ((k / 3 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by push_cast; ring
  have h_pow_eq : (b : ℝ) ^ k = (b : ℝ) ^ (k : ℝ) := (Real.rpow_natCast (b : ℝ) k).symm
  have h2ne : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by norm_num
  have h3ne : (3 : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by norm_num
  have h_sqrt : Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) ^ k) = (b : ℝ) ^ (k / 2) := by
    calc Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) ^ k) = ((b : ℝ) ^ k : ℝ) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2) := Real.sqrt_eq_rpow _
      _ = ((b : ℝ) ^ (k : ℝ)) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2) := by rw [h_pow_eq]
      _ = (b : ℝ) ^ ((k : ℝ) * ((1 : ℝ) / 2)) := by rw [← Real.rpow_mul hb]

          rw [show (2 * ((k / 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) / 2) = ((k / 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) from

      _ = (b : ℝ) ^ (k / 2) := Real.rpow_natCast (b : ℝ) (k / 2)

      _ = (b : ℝ) ^ ((k : ℝ) / 3) := by rw [show (k : ℝ) * ((1 : ℝ) / 3) = (k : ℝ) / 3 from by ring]

import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open BigOperators Real Nat Topology Rat

theorem bounded_common_multiple_radical_identity (b k : ℕ)    (h2 : 2 ∣ k) (h3 : 3 ∣ k) :
    Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) ^ k) - ((b : ℝ) ^ k) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3) =
      (b : ℝ) ^ (k / 2) - (b : ℝ) ^ (k / 3) := by
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := h2
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := h3
  have hk2 : k = k / 2 * 2 := by
    omega
  have hk3 : k = k / 3 * 3 := by
    omega
  have hbase2 :
      (b : ℝ) ^ k = ((b : ℝ) ^ (k / 2)) ^ 2 := by
    calc
      (b : ℝ) ^ k = (b : ℝ) ^ (k / 2 * 2) :=
        congrArg (fun t : ℕ => (b : ℝ) ^ t) hk2
      _ = ((b : ℝ) ^ (k / 2)) ^ 2 := by
        rw [pow_mul]
  have hbase3 :
      (b : ℝ) ^ k = ((b : ℝ) ^ (k / 3)) ^ 3 := by
    calc
      (b : ℝ) ^ k = (b : ℝ) ^ (k / 3 * 3) :=
        congrArg (fun t : ℕ => (b : ℝ) ^ t) hk3
      _ = ((b : ℝ) ^ (k / 3)) ^ 3 := by
        rw [pow_mul]
  have hsqrt :
      Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) ^ k) = (b : ℝ) ^ (k / 2) := by
    rw [hbase2, Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg]
    positivity
  have hrpow (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
      (x ^ 3) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3) = x := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul hx]
    norm_num
  have hcuberoot :
      ((b : ℝ) ^ k) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3) = (b : ℝ) ^ (k / 3) := by
    calc
      ((b : ℝ) ^ k) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3) =
          (((b : ℝ) ^ (k / 3)) ^ 3) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3) := by
            rw [hbase3]
      _ = (b : ℝ) ^ (k / 3) := by
        apply hrpow
        positivity
  rw [hsqrt, hcuberoot]
